# ACC Limited

<!-- Generated by `make client-docs`. Do not edit inside the markers. -->

Researched 2026-09-29 · status **partial** · Budget spent: repeated fetch_document timeouts on NSE archive PDFs (BRSR covering letter, FY2024-25 annual report) prevented reaching the statutory CSR-2/annexure tables with per-year prescribed CSR, average net profit and project-level spend; strongest available Tier-1 CIN sources (BSE, Scribd, LinkedIn, Tracxn) were HELD/robots-refused. Usable figures were confined to the FY2023-24 Integrated Report's Social & Relationship Capital narrative page. No figures at all were found for FY2022-23 (beyond a 15-month-year note) or FY2021-22.

ACC Limited is confirmed as the correct entity: a listed cement/building-materials company (incorporated 1936), now part of the Adani Group/Adani Portfolio, distinct from and not merged with Adani Foundation, which acts as ACC's CSR implementing arm ('ACC CSR, a part of the Adani Foundation'). For FY2023-24, ACC's own Integrated Report states CSR spend of Rs 37.49 crore, ~0.3 million (300,000) CSR beneficiaries, and self-reported footprint of 5,753 villages across 12 states impacting ~305,644 individuals, with specific footprint case studies in Amethi (Uttar Pradesh), Anakapalli (Andhra Pradesh) and Chikkaballapura (Karnataka), and programmes in community health (Health ATM kiosks, CT-scan facility) and education (Project Kalika Siri, Adani Competitive Coaching Centres, 16 ACC-supported schools). No statutory CSR-2/Annexure figures (prescribed CSR, average net profit, admin overheads, impact assessment cost) were retrieved for FY2023-24, FY2022-23 or FY2021-22 because the NSE/BSE regulatory filings either timed out on download or were access-restricted (HELD); a company disclosure notes FY2022-23 was an unusual 15-month period due to a financial-year-end change (Dec 31 to Mar 31), which limits year-on-year comparability. No CIN, PAN, CSR-1, grant-level, contact or stated-priority-geography records were found within budget.

Website: https://www.acclimited.com
